title: Sweetwater Grade 2 lesson plan (2nd Grade 26-27 Lesson Plans)
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Nov 2–6 | Phonics 11.2-11.6 / Wednesday (Session 27)] read and write words with final e and soft c and g.
[Nov 2–6 | Phonics 11.2-11.6 / Wednesday (Session 27)] read words with final e and the endings -ed and -ing.
[Nov 2–6 | Phonics 11.2-11.6 / Thursday (Session 28)] I can read and write words with str-, spl-, spr-, scr-, shr-, and thr-.
[Nov 2–6 | Phonics 11.2-11.6 / Friday (Sessions 29 & 30)] recognize and read words with open syllables.
[Nov 2–6 | Phonics 11.2-11.6 / Thursday (Session 28)] I can read words that show ownership.
[Nov 2–6 | Reading 11.2-11.6 / Monday (Session 26), Retrieval Activator] Using because to link an opinion and reason
[Nov 2–6 | SS 11.2-11.6 / Daily Plan, Wednesday] Lesson: Blue Ridge
[Nov 2–6 | SS 11.2-11.6 / Standard] SS2G1.b Locate on a physical map the major rivers: Savannah, Flint, and Chattahoochee.
[Nov 2–6 | Reading 11.2-11.6 / Monday (Session 26)] Today I will use information from a story to plan my opinion writing and support my opinion with reasons.
[Nov 2–6 | SS 11.2-11.6 / Daily Plan, Friday] Lesson: Coastal Plain
[Nov 2–6 | SS 11.2-11.6 / Daily Plan, Monday] Lesson: Appalachian Plateau & Ridge and Valley
[Nov 2–6 | SS 11.2-11.6 / Retrieval Activator, Thursday] The Blue Ridge is the highest point.
[Nov 2–6 | SS 11.2-11.6 / Retrieval Activator, Thursday] The Coastal Plain is the largest region.
